title.narrative: Lac Nokoué et Lagune de Porto-Novo

description.narrative: The project focuses on providing an Integrated Water Resource Management (IWRM) solution to hydrological, ecological and water quality challenges in Lac Nokoué in Benin.The project consists of ecological recovery through deepening of parts of the lake via dredging, use of dredged sediment for construction of flood defence structures and land reclamation for urban infrastructure development.
